title: SQL Query Generation

parsed_output.answer:
SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount
FROM Sales
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING SUM(total_amount) > 1000
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
parsed_output.explanation: Groups by customer_id, sums total_amount, filters totals > 1000 with HAVING, and orders descending.

evaluation.reason: SQL satisfies all required structural semantics.
